source: class Settings { @storage(allowed: .Session) public static int Offset = 0; }
class Detail(int salt) { public Vector2 Point = new(salt, salt); public int Rank = salt; }

class Part(int rank = 0, int salt = 5) : NeoObject { public int Rank = rank; public int Salt = salt + Settings.Offset; public Detail Detail = new(salt); public (Detail, int) Pair = (new Detail(salt), 0); }

class Parent : NeoObject { public override List<NeoObjectBase>? Children = [new Part { Name = "Sprite" }]; public Part SelectFirstSprite() { if (this.Children.FirstOrDefault((c) => c.Name == "Sprite") is not Part so) { throw new NeoError("Missing sprite"); } return so; } }

NeoVariant<Parent> Lambda = new(initialize: () => new Parent(), childOverrides: [new NeoAnimationChildOverride<Part>(() => { if (this.Children.FirstOrDefault((c) => c.Name == "Sprite") is not Part so) { throw new NeoError("Missing sprite"); } return so; }, new Partial<Part> { Rank = 8 })]);
NeoVariant<Parent> Method = new(initialize: () => new Parent(), childOverrides: [new NeoAnimationChildOverride<Part>(this.SelectFirstSprite, new Partial<Part> { Rank = 8 })]);
NeoVariant<Parent> Wrapper = new(initialize: () => new Parent(), childOverrides: [new NeoAnimationChildOverride<Part>(() => this.SelectFirstSprite(), new Partial<Part> { Rank = 8 })]);
NeoVariant<Parent> Higher = new(initialize: () => new Parent(), childOverrides: [new NeoAnimationChildOverride<Part>(this.SelectFirstSprite, new Partial<Part> { Rank = 12 })]);

NeoVariant<Parent> Detailed = new(initialize: () => new Parent(), childOverrides: [new NeoAnimationChildOverride<Part>(() => this.SelectFirstSprite(), new Partial<Part> { Detail = new { Point = new { x = 12 } } })]);
NeoVariant<Part> Own = new(initialize: () => new Part(4, 77), overrides: new { Rank = 6 });
NeoVariant<Parent> Tuple = new(initialize: () => new Parent(), childOverrides: [new NeoAnimationChildOverride<Detail>(() => this.SelectFirstSprite().Pair.Item1, new Partial<Detail> { Rank = 12 })]);
class Stored { @storage(allowed: .Save) public static Parent? Value = null; }

class Probe { public static void ReplaceWithOwnVariant(Parent parent) { var child = Part.Variants.Own.Initialize(); child.Name = "Sprite"; parent.Children = [child]; } public static int ReadPairRank(Parent parent) => parent.SelectFirstSprite().Pair.Item1.Rank; public static int TupleResult() { var parent = Parent.Variants.Plain.Initialize(); parent.Children = [new Part(0, 77) { Name = "Sprite" }]; parent.ToVariant(Parent.Variants.Tuple); return parent.SelectFirstSprite().Pair.Item1.Rank; } public static int TupleCloneResult() { var source = new Part(0, 77); var copy = source.Clone(); copy.Pair.Item1.Rank = 42; return source.Pair.Item1.Rank; } public static void Offset(int offset) { Settings.Offset = offset; } public static void ReplaceChild(Parent parent, int salt) { parent.Children = [new Part(0, salt) { Name = "Sprite" }]; } public static int ReadSalt(Parent parent) => parent.SelectFirstSprite().Salt; public static void PinRank(Parent parent, int rank) { parent.SelectFirstSprite().Rank = rank; } public static void Store(Parent parent) { Stored.Value = parent; } public static int ReadSavedRank() => Stored.Value!.SelectFirstSprite().Rank; public static int ReadSavedSalt() => Stored.Value!.SelectFirstSprite().Salt; public static void RaiseSaved() { Stored.Value!.ToVariant(Parent.Variants.Higher); } public static int ReadRank(Parent parent) => parent.SelectFirstSprite().Rank; public static int LambdaResult() { return Parent.Variants.Lambda.Initialize().SelectFirstSprite().Rank; } public static int MethodResult() { return Parent.Variants.Method.Initialize().SelectFirstSprite().Rank; } public static int WrapperResult() { return Parent.Variants.Wrapper.Initialize().SelectFirstSprite().Rank; } public static int ApplyResult() { var parent = new Parent(); parent.ToVariant(Parent.Variants.Method); return parent.SelectFirstSprite().Rank; } }
